Supported AI Services

{{APP_NAME}} integrates with third-party AI image generation services including Stability AI, OpenAI (DALL·E 3), Replicate, HuggingFace, and DeepAI (collectively, "AI Providers"). Use of these services is subject to the respective provider's terms of service and acceptable use policies.

Ownership of AI-Generated Images

Subject to each AI Provider's terms, you may own or hold a licence to images you generate through {{APP_NAME}}. {{APP_NAME}} makes no warranty that AI-generated images are free from third-party intellectual property claims. You are solely responsible for verifying the commercial usability of any AI-generated output, particularly before use in commercial print products.

EU AI Act — Transparency Notice EU AI Act Art. 50

In compliance with Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (EU AI Act) Article 50, images generated using AI tools within {{APP_NAME}} are identified as AI-generated content. If you publish or distribute AI-generated images created via {{APP_NAME}}, you are required to disclose that the images were AI-generated, in accordance with applicable law.

This obligation applies from 2 August 2026 for EU/EEA users.

Prohibited AI-Generated Content

You must not use AI generation features to create:

  • Content that violates any applicable law or regulation
  • Sexual or violent content involving minors
  • Non-consensual intimate imagery (deepfakes) of real individuals
  • Misinformation, disinformation, or deceptive content about real persons or events
  • Content that infringes a third party's intellectual property rights
  • Content regulated or prohibited under the AI Provider's acceptable use policy

Violation of this section may result in immediate account suspension and referral to relevant authorities.
